correctness.rationale: For each parity sector x^epsilon p(x^2), transformed full and local moments have alpha=mu+epsilon-1/2. Andreief/Cauchy–Binet gives the kth elementary symmetric sum as an integrated kernel determinant. The unique leading Vandermonde minor has coefficient H_{m-k}(alpha+2k)/H_m(alpha), giving e_k=D_{m,k} b^{k(alpha+k)}(1+O(b)). The scaled characteristic polynomial at z=b^{alpha+2k-1} has exactly two leading terms and a simple positive nonzero root D_k/D_{k-1}, yielding each distinct eigenvalue with relative O(b). Gamma-product Hankel and Selberg evaluations are standard; b=T^2 and parity sorting prove the claimed exponent ladder. Positive constants and N=1 were checked. Supplemental script CHECK.py passed 525 assertions; finite tests are not used to prove the all-rank claim.

value.rationale: The motivating work identifies serious conditioning of precisely these weighted polynomial concentration matrices. The new all-eigenvalue asymptotics give a sharp T^{-2(N-1)} condition-number law with explicit all-rank gamma products for both Dunkl families; show universal parity-interlaced exponents and independence of the Gegenbauer endpoint parameter at the exponent level. This motivated structural characterization is not an isolated finite example or a routine table recomputation. The fixed-N and access limitations are explicit.
